batch_get_secret_value.description: Read up to 20 secrets' values in one step, either named in a list or chosen by a filter (not both). Secrets that could not be read are listed in errors.
batch_get_secret_value.name: batch_get_secret_value

parameters.description: Up to 20 secret names or ARNs.
parameters.name: secret_ids

parameters.description: Which field Filter values are matched against.
parameters.name: filter_key

parameters.description: Up to 10 values; a secret matches if any one matches. Start a value with ! to exclude matches instead.
parameters.name: filter_values

parameters.description: Secrets per page when using a filter (1-20).
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.description: The next_token from the previous page. Leave empty for page 1.
parameters.name: next_token

has_more.description: True when there is another page; pass next_token to get it.

next_token.description: Pass to the same action's Next token to read the next page.

arn.description: The secret's ARN - usable anywhere a secret id is asked for.

create_secret.description: Create a secret, with its first value. AWS bills $0.40 per secret per month (prorated) from creation.

parameters.description: Unique within the region. Letters, digits and / _ + = . @ - ; use / to group, e.g. 'prod/billing/db'. Avoid ending with a hyphen and six characters, which looks like an ARN suffix.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: The value to store. Plain text, or JSON such as {"username": "app", "password": "..."} - the shape the console's key/value editor uses. An object from an earlier step is stored as JSON.
parameters.name: secret_value

parameters.description: A note shown in the console.
